# Havoc Custom Fonts Directory
Drop your downloaded font files (.ttf, .otf, or .woff2) into this directory:
C:\Users\PhatBLOKE\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\jarvis-pa\frontend\public\fonts

Supported filenames & CSS classes:
1. pdark.ttf / PerfectDark.ttf -> .font-perfect-dark
2. zerohour.ttf / ZeroHour.ttf -> .font-zero-hour
3. univox.ttf / Univox.ttf -> .font-univox
4. bladeline.ttf / Bladeline.ttf -> .font-bladeline
5. ailerons.otf / Ailerons.otf -> .font-ailerons
6. futurepolis.ttf / Futurepolis.ttf -> .font-futurepolis
7. anurati.otf / Anurati.otf -> .font-anurati
8. osiris.otf / Osiris.otf -> .font-osiris
9. numono.otf / NuMono.otf -> .font-numono
10. bios.otf / Bios.otf -> .font-bios
11. wraith.otf / Wraith.otf -> .font-wraith
12. ykar.otf / Ykar.otf -> .font-ykar
